title: Do You Really Know Your ICP? Why It Matters and How to Find Out

reader_summary.headline: ICP is the central nervous system of the entire customer journey.
reader_summary.overview: ICP is the central nervous system of the entire customer journey. Conversion rates, expansion rates, the length of your sales cycles. If you look at those, they're almost all telling you something about your ICP at all times.

key_points.text: If you're like, we sell to everyone, we build to everyone or everyone, maybe you're not selling to anybody yet.
key_points.evidence_quote: If you're like, we sell to everyone, we build to everyone or everyone, maybe you're not selling to anybody yet.

key_points.text: It not only shows who you need to target and what you need to target the customer with.
key_points.evidence_quote: It not only shows who you need to target and what you need to target the customer with, but also why the customer would need your product.

key_points.text: Your ideal customer profile or ICP is the load star of your company.
key_points.evidence_quote: Your ideal customer profile or ICP is the load star of your company.

key_points.text: It defines who you're building, marketing, and selling your products to.
key_points.evidence_quote: It defines who you're building, marketing, and selling your products to.

thesis: The speakers argue that an Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) is the central nervous system of the customer journey and defines who a company builds, markets to, and sells to. They caution that founders often mistakenly believe they have found product-market fit simply because they are growing, whereas early success can sometimes be a curse that masks a lack of a defined ICP.
